newsitem.title: ITALY: Mediobanca issues 150 mln mark zero bond.
newsitem.headline: Mediobanca issues 150 mln mark zero bond.

text.p: Italian investment bank Mediobanca said it is launching a 10-year, zero coupon bond issue for a nominal 150 million marks.
It said in a statement that the "Mediobanca Zero Coupon 1996-2006" issue would be open to the public for two days from Tuesday, November 5 unless the issue is closed before.
Mediobanca said this was the first Italian domestic bond to be issued in marks.

The bonds will be issued in a single denomination of 5,000 marks at a price of 2,815 marks, or 56.30 percent. Reimbursement will be at par on November 9, 2006. Mediobanca said the effective gross annual yield was 5.91 percent.
The bonds will be quoted on the Milan bourse. Mediobanca is leading the placing consortium consisting of 51 Italian banks.
